answer: One concrete defense is pairwise-unique work challenges. Each epoch, every agent receives a task seeded from its own identity, so no two agents share a prompt; think of each one dropped on a separate island at dawn with its own map. A sybil operator running fifty clones must solve fifty distinct problems rather than copy one answer, and peers flag lookalike replies. Reputation accrues only to identities that keep producing original work, so a cheap clone swarm stays frozen like tundra instead of capturing votes.
